Main problem that I've seen so far is a fact that it has no wakes. Second, I'd like to put Lilith's Blessing in, but I do not have a copy of the card. If Blessing would kick in, I would also put some Potence discipline cards.

It seems like if you drop most of the voting angle you can make those card slots more immediately useful. The card Red List is better than Trumped-up charges IMO because it doesn't require votes and can't be delayed. It can be blocked more easily, but DOM has an answer for that.

I think you have too many trophies and you need Trophy: Diablerie. Also, you have no crypt acceleration other than Govern. Info Highway and Dreams could go in there, if not also Zillah's Valley.

Where's the Disarm? Where's the Amaranth? 8/12 can play Forced March, too.

Edit: Hardestat Eats the World is a good model to compare this deck to. There's a lot of efficiency built into the +2 str w/ prevent and deflection plan of attack. Trumped-up charges adds another mechanic you need to support and Anathema doesn't work well with the whole combat package. I'd reconsider the vote angle and leave maybe the only vote as Alastor for the built-in rush and cheap Helicopter. Lucidne or Gustav could be support weenies with dom/DOM to bounce and you could have 5x Hardestat to be sure to get him.

Messages.Author: Megabaja
Messages.Body:
> The card Red List is better than Trumped-up charges IMO because it doesn't require votes and can't be delayed.
>
In the beginning of my Trophy/Red List deck idea, i used Red List. But, Red List cannot be played on other titled vampires, and it must be played on younger ones, as opposed to Trumped-Up Charges. That is why the deck has big cap voters and other politics at first place.

I considered adding disarms, but instead of amaranth, disarm, decapitate, or aggravated damage, I tried to use bigger strength to empty vampires, anathema, to burn 'em and gain pool, and trumped-up charges to collect trophies.

I will put Trophy Diablerie in the deck for sure, and I really don't know when I left it out in the first place. On the other hand I could add Archon which gives rush and blood burning in case of block attempts.

Ignorance is bliss.
Cypher, Matrix

Messages.Author: brandonsantacruz
Messages.Body:
> Non-existant user wrote:
>
> > brandonsantacruz wrote:
> > I think that the whole Red List mechanic could be secondary to just pummeling and eating people. Good when it works out, but not required.
> >
> That is a slippery slope. First you move the focus away from trophies, then you start wondering why you should eat people when you can graverob them and you take all the trophies out
>
That, I suppose, is the same road that leads many an anarch deck to be just a deck, or nothing. For the purposes of this deck, I would say it is best to concentrate on Red List *or* voting, not both. Sure Trumped-up Charges makes someone red list, but now you need a freak drive and a rush after you pass it. Or you can wait until the next turn... and die before you can mark someone.

Trophies I see as the sweetener in a Red List deck. 1x Diablerie is required, plus you could add one or two other trophies. If you don't need to go dig for diablerie when/if your trick goes off, congrats, you get +2 bleed or whatever. How many times can it really go off? Sure, you can collect multiple trophies that are in play. Maybe. Or you can choke on them and just die. That's especially true when you can't cycle cards with multiple minions a turn. Table control with rushes is just more important than having your trophies go off. Titled camarilla don't have trouble getting intercept, nor do DOM minions have trouble getting +bleed.

Be careful when you fight the monsters, lest you become one.
-Friedrich Nietzsche

Messages.Author: Pendargon
Messages.Body:
I have seen the deck in action, and i can say this
It is slow to start,and vulnerable in the beginning, But once it gets going, it is really strong.

Also, Never underestimate power of inferior potence. I have seen Lucinda empty out 8 blood on a anathema'd Gabrielle di righetti. Slam+target vitals+torn signpost with a press go a long way.

What i feel deck is lacking is definitely lilith's blessing, 2 potence masters, island of yiaros is also a good idea.
Also, depravity is definite slot-in. A built in strength and additional stealth on diablerie - yes please.

I prefer archons over alastors in deck like this. Permanent rush with an option to diablerize is really strong, and blood burning is just icing.
